valid_for.lidar: RS-Fairy, config.yaml as of 2026-10-11, mounted facing forward

method: measure_sync_offset.py, 3 daylight sessions, LiDAR reference, --lidar-range-pct 10 (plate surface); pct 20 gave radar +12.67 ms
note: offsets are ADDED to each sensor's time. Re-measure if firmware/frame period, DCA delay, camera mode or LiDAR config changes.
